anita: Noticing a slow uptick in GPU Pending in us-west1a after we provisioned the new ampere-small rack (r-ampa-12). Tiny training jobs (0.125-0.5 GPU) are getting placed across racks and then preempted ~30-90s later. Anyone seeing similar?

leo: saw it too. started ~21:10 PDT. metrics show per-rack free_gpu_fragments spiking; scheduler is favoring nvlink groups for larger gang affinity, which scatters fractional requests into fragmented legs.

infra-bot: :warning: metric alert: us-west1a.fragmented_slots_pct = 14.7% (15m), preempt_events = 89 (15m).

dan: sample scheduler trace: `kubectl -n kube-system exec scheduler-0 -- cat /var/log/scheduler.log | tail -n 200 | grep -i fragment` ->
```
W1006 21:11:02.112 scheduler_predicate.go:87] Pod tiny-train-abc failed predicate: InsufficientGPUResource (node r-ampa-02 available=0.25)
I1006 21:11:02.113 scheduler_score.go:45] Node r-ampa-05 score=5 (rack_affinity=9, fragment_penalty=12)
```
Small pods get score suppressed and bounce.

anita: Two mitigation proposals: 1) Introduce a packing-floor heuristic for small GPU requests (floor=0.5) so scheduler treats anything <0.5 as needing at least 0.5 leg when scoring, reducing cross-rack scatter. 2) Increase pod preemption grace windows / taint toleration for tiny pods (e.g., toleration-seconds=120) so they don't hop immediately on transient noise.

leo: both make sense. risk: packing-floor increases perceived minimum and could leave some GPU capacity unused (wasted legs). But tradeoff is lower churn and fewer cold-starts. Ops estimation: may increase reserved slack by ~6% in canary AZ.

ops_pm: cost/ops guardrails: run a 4h canary in us-west1a-c only. Keys to monitor: fragmented_slots_pct, preempt_events, pod_start_95, attach_detach_latency. Revert if preempt_events increases by >8% or pod_start_95 increases >10% over baseline within 30m.

dan: will add a synthetic load job to exercise the canary: spin 150 tiny pods with ramp 2s/pod and measure placement churn. Also will add telemetry tags: experiment=pack-floor, pack_floor_value=0.5, region=us-west1a-c.

anita: config snippet i'll use (scheduler configmap patch):
```
policies:
  placement:
    packing_floor:
      default: 0.0
      small_request_override:
        threshold: 0.5
        value: 0.5
  preemption:
    tiny_pod_toleration_seconds: 120
```
I'll apply as a canary patch at 03:00 UTC tomorrow and have an automated rollback job if conditions breach.

leo: one more note: check kubelet attach/detach latencies on new rack nodes (r-ampa-*)we saw a small bump earlier which may amplify requeues. adding `kubelet.attach_latency_ms` to dashboards.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary scheduled: us-west1a-c @ 03:00 UTC. revert_job=canary-1699998765-rollback. monitoring panels updated.

ops_pm: ok. post results in #eng-infra after first 30m and at end of window. If stable, we can consider wider rollout with tuned floor (0.4-0.5).

dan: will push the stress probe and baseline exports tonight. tagging oncall for heads-up. :bell:
